nodes.name: ResearchPhase.tsx
nodes.summary: Workflow-1 research phase that bundles five sequential step components (niche, audience, purpose, goals, exemplar swoop) used to gather creator strategy inputs.

nodes.name: NicheSelectionStep
nodes.summary: Step component letting the creator pick a content niche to scope downstream research and prediction.

nodes.name: TargetAudienceStep
nodes.summary: Step component capturing target-audience profile (demographics, pains, interests) for the workflow context.

nodes.name: ContentPurposeStep
nodes.summary: Step component for selecting the creator's content purpose (educate, entertain, convert, etc.).

nodes.name: GoalsKPIStep
nodes.summary: Step component collecting goals and KPI targets that downstream prediction components calibrate against.

nodes.name: ExemplarSwoopStep
nodes.summary: Step component that surfaces exemplar viral videos in the chosen niche and lets the creator pick references.

nodes.name: CaptionEditor.tsx
nodes.summary: Caption editing UI for the redesigned workflow that drafts and refines social-post captions tied to a generated script.

nodes.name: CaptionEditor
nodes.summary: Renders a textarea-based caption editor with badges/buttons for length, tone, and hashtag suggestions.

nodes.name: CreatorScore.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the creator's gamified score and streak loaded from local storage in the redesigned workflow.

nodes.name: getStoredStreak
nodes.summary: Reads the creator's daily streak counter from local storage with safe defaults when missing.

nodes.name: CreatorScore
nodes.summary: Renders the creator-score badge with streak and tier visualization for the redesigned workflow header.

nodes.name: DynamicCTASuggester.tsx
nodes.summary: Suggests call-to-action variants for a given content purpose and exposes the suggestion list via a helper export.

nodes.name: DynamicCTASuggester
nodes.summary: React component rendering CTA option chips that map to the workflow's chosen content purpose.

nodes.name: FourByFourBeatEditor.tsx
nodes.summary: Editor for the redesigned workflow's 4x4 viral beat sheet (hook, retention, CTA, payoff quadrants) with viral exemplar reference panels.

nodes.name: ProofBadge
nodes.summary: Small badge component showing viral-proof evidence (views/engagement) for a referenced exemplar.

nodes.name: ViralExamplesPanel
nodes.summary: Side panel listing viral exemplars and their beat content so the creator can borrow proven patterns.

nodes.name: BeatQuadrant
nodes.summary: Renders a single quadrant of the 4x4 beat grid with editable content and per-beat prompts.

nodes.name: FourByFourBeatEditor
nodes.summary: Top-level editor wiring four BeatQuadrants into a 4x4 grid and tracking aggregate beat state.

nodes.name: GenerateCompleteScript.tsx
nodes.summary: Generates a full script from the 4x4 beats and content strategy, with a mock fallback for development.

nodes.name: generateMockContent
nodes.summary: Produces a deterministic placeholder script when the AI generation backend is unavailable.

nodes.name: GenerateCompleteScript
nodes.summary: Triggers full-script generation from the beat grid and surfaces progress/errors to the workflow UI.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports the redesigned workflow components and supporting types for consumers.

nodes.name: PersonalizationToast.tsx
nodes.summary: Transient toast that surfaces personalization tips and creator-profile nudges in the redesigned workflow.

nodes.name: PersonalizationToast
nodes.summary: Renders an animated toast notification with personalization hints tied to the creator profile.

nodes.name: ResultsTracker.tsx
nodes.summary: Captures post-publication results (views, engagement) and feeds them back into the workflow tracking loop.

nodes.name: ResultsTracker
nodes.summary: Renders form inputs for actual published-video metrics and stages them for the prediction-feedback loop.

nodes.name: SEOHealthIndicator.tsx
nodes.summary: Evaluates and visualizes SEO/keyword health for the workflow's drafted script, caption, and beats.

nodes.name: SEOHealthIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders the SEO health card with keyword occurrence counts, status icons, and remediation guidance.

nodes.name: ShipPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Final-stage ship panel summarizing viral score, SEO, and beats before the creator publishes the video.

nodes.name: ShipPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the publish-ready summary with overall score, per-dimension grades, and a ship CTA.

nodes.name: StrategyCreator.tsx
nodes.summary: Form-driven creator for new content strategies that seeds the redesigned workflow with niche, audience, and goals.

nodes.name: StrategyCreator
nodes.summary: Renders the multi-field strategy creation form and inserts a ContentStrategy row when submitted.

nodes.name: StrategyPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays the active content strategy summary card with quick-edit affordances for the redesigned workflow.

nodes.name: StrategyPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the current ContentStrategy with badges for niche, audience, purpose, and goals.

nodes.name: ViralReadinessMeter.tsx
nodes.summary: Composite meter visualizing how viral-ready the current beat grid is across hook, retention, payoff, and CTA dimensions.

nodes.name: ViralReadinessMeter
nodes.summary: Renders the gauge UI and readiness level labels derived from the current beat content.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting WorkflowPicker and SaveIndicator helpers for the workflow shell.

nodes.name: SaveIndicator.tsx
nodes.summary: Tiny status badge that shows whether the workflow has unsaved changes, is saving, or is fully persisted.

nodes.name: SaveIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders an inline save-status indicator for the workflow header.

nodes.name: WorkflowPicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Server-backed workflow picker letting the creator select an existing workflow or start a new one.

nodes.name: WorkflowPicker
nodes.summary: Renders the workflow list, handles selection callbacks, and emits create-new actions.

nodes.name: WorkflowPickerLocal.tsx
nodes.summary: Local-storage variant of the workflow picker used when Supabase is unavailable or for anonymous drafts.

nodes.name: getTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Formats a timestamp into a human-friendly relative time string (e.g., '5m ago').

nodes.name: loadWorkflowsFromStorage
nodes.summary: Reads cached workflow metadata from localStorage with parse-error tolerance.

nodes.name: WorkflowPickerLocal
nodes.summary: Renders the local-cached workflow list and handles selection/deletion in localStorage.

nodes.name: AnalysisScreen.tsx
nodes.summary: Loading/analysis screen shown while the prediction pipeline crunches a video, driven by GlobalState.

nodes.name: AnalysisScreen
nodes.summary: Renders the analysis spinner and progress messaging while a prediction run is in flight.

nodes.name: AppIntegration.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level integration component that wires screen transitions to the global StateContext.

nodes.name: getTransitionDirection
nodes.summary: Returns the forward/back animation direction given old and new screen identifiers.

nodes.name: AppIntegration
nodes.summary: Switches between the entry/analysis/results screens based on StateContext and orchestrates transitions.

nodes.name: EntryScreen.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing screen that captures the creator's initial video URL and seeds the global workflow state.

nodes.name: EntryScreen
nodes.summary: Renders the URL-input entry view and dispatches the start-analysis action against GlobalState.

nodes.name: ErrorBoundary.tsx
nodes.summary: React error boundary that catches render errors and surfaces a friendly fallback UI.

nodes.name: ErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: Class component implementing getDerivedStateFromError/componentDidCatch to render a fallback when children throw.

nodes.name: ExpertInsightPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Large expert-insight side panel that surfaces qualitative AI analysis (hook, retention, CTA) tied to a trending template.

nodes.name: ExpertInsightPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the full expert-insight UI with tabs, editable notes, and recommendation cards for the selected template.

nodes.name: FeatureAccess.tsx
nodes.summary: Wrapper component that gates child UI behind subscription-tier checks pulled from AuthContext.

nodes.name: getTierValue
nodes.summary: Maps a subscription tier string to a numeric rank used for tier comparisons.

nodes.name: FeatureAccess
nodes.summary: Renders children only when the current user's tier meets or exceeds the required tier.

nodes.name: FeatureDebug.tsx
nodes.summary: Developer debug widget that prints FeatureContext flags and Firebase connection status.

nodes.name: FeatureDebug
nodes.summary: Renders the in-app feature-flag debug overlay used in local development.
